authorization: Caller must authorize scope and every retry before dispatch
identity: Volatile transactionId until preview seals immutable requestId/payloadHash; unknown IDs never create work

operations.description: Create an empty private draft at the current revision
operations.name: transaction.begin

operations.description: Append validated commands once to an unsealed draft
operations.name: transaction.apply

count.description: New copies; total instances including source = count + 1

divide.description: Divide displacement or sweep into count intervals, including endpoint

operations.description: Read draft version, lifetime and prepared result
operations.name: transaction.describe

operations.description: Run a bounded read against the private proposed model
operations.name: transaction.inspect

operations.description: Page direct changed records in the private proposed model
operations.name: transaction.diff

operations.description: Seal a complete draft and issue an immutable durable commit identity
operations.name: transaction.preview

operations.description: Discard an uncommitted volatile draft or cancel its sealed request
operations.name: transaction.abort

operations.description: Publish the sealed request once after confirmed durability
operations.name: transaction.commit

operations.description: Cancel pending work or return its original committed outcome
operations.name: transaction.cancel

operations.description: Resolve pending, committed, aborted or unknown durable outcome
operations.name: transaction.status

operations.description: Resolve uncertain publication from verified durable evidence
operations.name: transaction.reconcile

publication: One revision and undo entry after co-recorded candidate/outcome durability; no command replay
